cohort: 152 women with cardiac disease referred to a perinatal cardiac service between 2009 and 2016
finding: The study found that women with cardiac disease are at increased risk of preterm birth and high acuity in the peripartum period, but overall maternal and perinatal outcomes were favorable.
mod_finding: 51% of women required a caesarean section.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 38 weeks 4 days
